neighbours.label: the auxiliary verb of an inverted exclamation ('boy was it big!', 'man, did we laugh'): exclamative inversion, not a question
fire: We drove to the coast last weekend, and boy was it windy out there!
I tried the new chili at the diner, and boy was it spicy.
She finally opened the present, and wow was she surprised!
We watched the final match last night, and man did they play hard.
The kids built a snow fort today, and boy were they proud of it!
My uncle told the old fishing story again, and boy did we laugh.
They repainted the whole barn in red, and boy does it look sharp now!
He carried the sofa up five floors alone, and boy was he tired after.
quiet: We drove to the coast last weekend, and it was very windy out there.
I tried the new chili at the diner, and it was quite spicy.
She finally opened the present, and she was surprised by it.
We watched the final match last night, and they played hard.
The kids built a snow fort today, and they were proud of it.
My uncle told the old fishing story again, and we all laughed.
They repainted the whole barn in red, and it looks sharp now.
He carried the sofa up five floors alone, and he was tired after.
